samples.question: A blue line starts at an orange ring, runs along a shared trunk to a junction, then splits into two branches. Each branch ends in a coloured terminal dot (red or green), and several black waypoint dots are drawn along each branch. Starting at the ring, walk along the blue line to the junction and then follow both branches to their ends. Which coloured terminal, red or green, is on the branch that has MORE black waypoints along it? Answer red or green.
